title: Settings

theme.title: Theme
theme.body: Light is the default — a white content area with black and gold text. Dark restores the Sovereign Agentic brand palette (gold #c8a24a on #0c0b0d). The navigation stays dark in both modes. Your choice is saved on this device.

technical.title: Show technical details
technical.body: Off by default. Switch it on to see the engineering panels on detail pages, such as Under the hood. Your choice is saved on this device.

language.title: Language
language.body: The language of the whole OS for you, and the language the AI answers you in. Your own content — dataset names, files, knowledge — stays as you wrote it. Saved to your account, on every device.
language.label: Language
language.failed: Could not save your language. Try again.

hint: See <link>About / Licenses</link> for the full component + license list.
hintAdmin: See About / Licenses for the full component + license list. Deployment identity is set via OS_TENANT, OS_DOMAIN, OS_NAMESPACE, OS_PROFILE, and OS_VERSION.

appPermissions.title: Apps that act as you
appPermissions.body: Apps built in the OS that you allowed to sign you in. Each one can do only what is listed, and never more than your own role allows. Revoke one and its next call as you is refused.
appPermissions.empty: You have not allowed any app yet.
appPermissions.failed: Your app permissions cannot be read right now. Try again in a moment.

appConsent.title: Allow {app} to act as you?
appConsent.subtitle: Domain {domain} · {env}

read.title: It may read
read.identityOnly: Only who you are: your name and account

appConsent.agents: Agents it may run as you
appConsent.actions: Actions it may take as you
appConsent.never: It can never approve requests, change settings or do more than your own role allows. The OS checks every call.
appConsent.revokeHint: You can take this back at any time under My Settings → App permissions.
appConsent.errorTitle: Signing in to the app did not work

errors.invalidApp: The sign-in link does not name a valid app.
errors.invalidEnv: The sign-in link names an unknown environment.
errors.pkceS256Required: The app must protect its sign-in with PKCE (S256).
errors.invalidCodeChallenge: The sign-in link is incomplete (code challenge).
errors.invalidRedirectUri: The sign-in link has no valid return address.
errors.appNotFound: This app does not exist or you cannot see it.
errors.unregisteredRedirectUri: The return address is not one of this app's registered addresses. Nothing was sent.
errors.consentUnavailable: Your app permissions cannot be checked right now. Try again in a moment.
errors.consentRequestExpired: This sign-in request expired. Open the app again.
errors.consentNotAllowed: Policy did not allow this permission. Nothing was changed.
errors.appTokenUnavailable: App sign-in is not set up on this installation yet. Ask your admin.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Open the app again.
